summary: Sangrix Inc. (formerly Bit Origin Ltd) filed a Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, reporting shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting on August 21, 2026, to change the corporate name from BIT ORIGIN LTD to SANGRIX INC. Directors approved the change on August 26, 2026, and changed the trading symbol from BTOG to SGRX. Trading under the new name and symbol begins on Nasdaq on September 4, 2026, with no change to CUSIP. No shareholder action is required. The rebranding reflects a transition toward AI computing infrastructure, including a previously announced transaction for sixteen NVIDIA Blackwell B300 AI servers. This is a routine name and symbol change, not a special situation.
